thread.title: Qorvo, Skyworks: Macquarie Says Don’t Fret Lower iPhone Estimates

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Qorvo, Skyworks: Macquarie Says Don’t Fret Lower iPhone Estimates
text:
Chip makers are in the grip at the moment of declining estimates for Apple ’s ( AAPL ) iPhone, but Macquarie Research ’s Srini Pajjuri urges investors in Qorvo ( QRVO ) and Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) and Broadcom ( AVGO ) to keep the faith.
Writing that 2018 is going to be a “ transition year ” waiting for 5G wireless technology to get underway, Pajjuri nevertheless sees "enough incremental content opportunities (4x4 MIMO, 802.11ax etc.) for RF IC vendors to outgrow the Semi industry (ex-Memory) this year."
Hence, "We believe valuations are largely discounting slower growth and that risk / reward is attractive, in particular for Broadcom and Skyworks ."
This afternoon brought word from J.P. Morgan analyst Narci Chang that production data for the iPhone X suggests “builds” of the device will be down 50% this quarter from last quarter’s level, prompting the analyst to conclude that the “peak” in iPhone X orders has taken place sooner than expected, according to a summary of the report provided by TheFlyontheWall .
That follows a downgrade of Apple stock yesterday by Atlantic Equities analyst James Cordwell over similar remarks.
Pajjuri cuts estimates for both Qorvo and Skyworks for the March quarter to reflect "slightly slower iPhone X component order assumptions, and slower China market recovery.” Although Samsung Electronics ( 005930KS ) should help orders with the expected debut of its “ Galaxy S9 ” smartphone, expectations are still too high for this quarter, he believes.
He now models Skyworks making $943 million this quarter in revenue, and $1.64 in EPS, down from $947 million and $1.66 previously modeled. For Qorvo, he models $765 million in revenue and $1.36 EPS versus $791 million and $1.44 previously.
As for valuations,
We reiterate OP on SWKS given the above average growth, solid margin execution, attractive valuation, and a strong balance sheet. Going by the recent consolidation trend in the Semi industry, we believe the stock can benefit from diversification through an accretive M&A. The company has a strong balance sheet with $1.6b net cash with about half of its cash balance offshore (the company also generates about half of its cash flow offshore). We believe the new tax bill gives the company added flexibility, see a higher likelihood of M&A (see “Do they need M&A). For QRVO, while we like the company prospects in non-mobile as well as its BAW expertise, we do not see many immediate catalysts. We are skeptical about share gains in BAW at Apple and believe that the stock is likely range-bound in the near term.
Shares of Qorvo are down 12 cents at $67.20 in late trading, Skyworks is unchanged at $99.37, and Broadcom is down $1.45, or half a percent, at $261.45.
